# Experiment E4 of docs/spec/text-component.md, section 8.7: the plain string of a server and the unresolved contents.
# Source: the log of the vanilla server, and the log of the vanilla client. An item replace command with a custom name
# sends the name to the player and to the console as an unresolved text. A loot table of a data pack
# gives a text that the game read from JSON. The data pack is in the folder pack-json of this directory.
# The line of the client shows the plain string of the client. The line of the server shows the plain string of the server.
# The command wraps the name of the item in square brackets.
# The player is the offline test player Recorder. The vanilla client of the project version joined the vanilla server
# on 127.0.0.1. The server ran in offline mode. The console of the server gave each command.
# Each case has a header line with the id, the line of the command, and the log lines that the case wrote.
# A line that starts with "C " is a line of the client log. A line that starts with "S " is a line of the server log.
# A command with no output line wrote nothing in that log. The text after "[CHAT] " is the plain string that the process makes.
#
# case UNR-all
> item replace entity Recorder weapon.mainhand with minecraft:stone[custom_name=[{selector:"@e[ type = cow ]"},"|",{score:{name:"@s",objective:"o"}},"|",{nbt:"Health",entity:"@s"},"|",{keybind:"key.jump"},"|",{atlas:"minecraft:blocks",sprite:"minecraft:block/stone",fallback:"FB"}]]
C [01:44:35] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] [Server: Replaced 1 slot(s) on Recorder with [@e[ type = cow ]|||Space|FB]]
S [01:44:35] [Server thread/INFO]: System chat: Replaced 1 slot(s) on Recorder with [@e[ type = cow ]|||key.jump|FB]
# case DSP001-f-item
> item replace entity Recorder weapon.mainhand with minecraft:stone[custom_name={selector:"@e[type=cow]",extra:["!"]}]
C [01:44:35] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] [Server: Replaced 1 slot(s) on Recorder with [@e[type=cow]!]]
S [01:44:35] [Server thread/INFO]: System chat: Replaced 1 slot(s) on Recorder with [@e[type=cow]!]
# case UNR-selector
> item replace entity Recorder weapon.mainhand with minecraft:stone[custom_name={selector:"@e[type=cow]"}]
C [01:44:36] [Render thread/INFO]: [System] [CHAT] [Server: Replaced 1 slot(s) on Recorder with [@e[type=cow]]]
S [01:44:36] [Server thread/INFO]: System chat: Replaced 1 slot(s) on Recorder with [@e[type=cow]]
